title: A query-log delivery refused by its sync logs no reason, and kbmon raises REFUSED though another run delivered the rows
goal: When kbgit.py sync exits 2 under ql_deliver.deliver, the distill log names the refusal's reason (dirty tree, an operation in progress, another sync's lock) even when the sync printed a pushed: line, and a refusal that a concurrent run's push made moot (its rows already on origin/main) does not raise kbmon's REFUSED alert. Seen 5 times in this clone's distill.log on 2026-10-26, each right after another run's successful push; noted by the unattended orchestrator during SP-hxxn6fnv.

run:
import os,sys;p=os.path.expanduser("~/it-ops-kb/_cache/querylog/distill.log")
L=open(p).read().splitlines() if os.path.exists(p) else []
bad=[i for i,l in enumerate(L) if "sync exit 2: nothing pushed" in l and i>0 and L[i-1].strip()=="pushed: no"]
print("refusals logged with no reason:",len(bad));sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

repro_reason: the refusal happens only when two session-end distill runs overlap on the shared query-log worktree, a race no planted input reproduces on demand; the repro reads this clone's distill.log for a refusal logged without its reason
